quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: Check your rearview mirrors:

options.text: Often to see how traffic is moving behind you.
To see if a vehicle is in your blind spot.
Only when you are slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often to see how traffic is moving behind you.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors often while driving. This helps you know where other vehicles are around you.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle is approaching with its siren and flashing lights while you are in an intersection. You should:

options.text: Stop immediately in the intersection until it passes.
Pull to the right of the intersection and stop.
Continue through the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue through the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.
questions.explanation: If you are in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches with flashing lights or a siren, finish crossing the intersection. Then drive to the right and stop. You must let emergency vehicles pass.

questions.question: When parking your vehicle on a hill:

options.text: One of your rear wheels should touch the curb.
Use your parking brake and leave the vehicle in "park."
Your front wheels should be parallel to the road, if there is no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your parking brake and leave the vehicle in "park."
questions.explanation: Always use your parking brake and leave your vehicle in "park" when parking on a hill. If there is no curb, turn your front wheels away from the center of the road. If there is a curb, turn your wheels toward it when going uphill, or away from it when going downhill.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are:
questions.correctAnswerText: White.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually white with black, red, or green text. They tell you the traffic laws you must follow.

questions.question: To avoid hydroplaning while driving in rain, you should:

options.text: Drive at a speed appropriate for ideal conditions.
Apply your brakes as soon as your car starts to skid.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads and your tires lose contact with the road. Slow down in rainy conditions to prevent this.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the freeway, you should not:

options.text: Continue on the freeway and find an alternate route to your destination.
Proceed to the next exit, leave the freeway, and return to your proper exit.
Back up on the road or shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Back up on the road or shoulder.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on the freeway or shoulder. Continue to the next exit instead. Other drivers do not expect vehicles backing up, which can cause crashes.

questions.question: When entering an interstate on a short entrance ramp with no acceleration lane, you should:

options.text: Immediately enter the far-right traffic lane on the interstate and speed up to match the flow of traffic.
Use the shoulder of the main road to get up to the speed of traffic.
Speed up and enter the interstate only after you have identified a gap in traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up and enter the interstate only after you have identified a gap in traffic.
questions.explanation: On a short entrance ramp with no acceleration lane, wait for a clear gap in traffic before speeding up and entering the interstate.

questions.question: If you park facing uphill where there is no curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Turn your wheels toward the edge of the road.
Turn your wheels away from the edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels toward the edge of the road.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill with no curb, turn your wheels toward the edge of the road. This keeps your vehicle from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: You exit the freeway on a ramp that curves downhill. You should:

options.text: Slow to a safe speed before the curve.
Slow to the posted speed limit for the freeway.
Wait until you have entered the curve to begin braking.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to a safe speed before the curve.
questions.explanation: Always slow down before entering a curve. You cannot see ahead in a curve, and braking while turning may cause your vehicle to skid.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: In a motor vehicle on a highway, it is:

options.text: Illegal to drink alcohol or have open alcohol containers.
Legal to drink alcohol if you are not the driver.
Legal to drink alcohol while driving if you are not drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Illegal to drink alcohol or have open alcohol containers.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive while under the influence of alcohol. Drivers and passengers cannot have open alcohol containers in a moving vehicle.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the path is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: On a green arrow, you must:

options.text: Yield to any vehicle, bicycle, or pedestrian in the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to any vehicle, bicycle, or pedestrian in the intersection.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go. Turn in the direction of the arrow only after you yield to any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians still in the intersection.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is ahead.
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: You should always travel at:

options.text: The speed of vehicles around you.
A speed that is safe for road and weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: A speed that is safe for road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: Drive at a speed that is safe for road conditions, weather, and the legal speed limit. Never drive above the speed limit. Slow down when conditions are not ideal.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not make a right turn at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Road construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange color is used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: This sign indicates:
questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers about upcoming railroad crossings. Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards and special conditions.

questions.question: What do broken yellow lines mean on streets and highways?

options.text: They separate lanes going the same direction.
They separate lanes going opposite directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: They separate lanes going opposite directions.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A dashed yellow line means passing is allowed when it is safe.

questions.question: When should you be most careful turning or stopping in rain?

options.text: After it has rained all day.
One half hour after rain stops.
During the first half hour of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first half hour of rain.
questions.explanation: Be extra careful during the first half hour of rain. Oil from cars mixes with rain water on the pavement, making it very slippery.

questions.question: A driver license is a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Privilege.
questions.explanation: Driving is a privilege, not a right. All drivers must drive safely. If you misuse this privilege, it can be taken away.

questions.question: When should you use high beam headlights at night?

options.text: When no other vehicles are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: When no other vehicles are nearby.
questions.explanation: Use high beams when you are not following another vehicle and there are no oncoming cars. High beams let you see twice as far as low beams. Use them on unfamiliar roads, in construction areas, or where people may be on the roadside.

questions.question: Alcohol is a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Depressant.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows your judgment and makes your reflexes slower and less reliable.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this road sign?
questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that a divided highway is starting. Keep to the right.

questions.question: When do large trucks most likely lose speed?

options.text: When driving up long or steep hills.
When driving in long, gentle curves.
When driving down long, gentle hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving up long or steep hills.
questions.explanation: Large trucks take longer to speed up than smaller vehicles. They lose speed going up long or steep hills. Drive carefully behind trucks and give them extra space on hills.

questions.question: You are parking uphill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?
questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the roadside
questions.explanation: When parking uphill or downhill on a road with no curb, turn your wheels so the car rolls away from the road center if the brakes fail.

questions.question: As you approach the top of a hill, you should:

options.text: Be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: You cannot see what is beyond a hill or around a curve. A vehicle may be stalled out of sight. Slow down as you approach hills and curves so you can stop if necessary.

questions.question: If a tire blows out while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Hold the steering wheel tight and brake lightly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel tight and brake lightly.
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, grip the steering wheel tightly and keep the car straight. Slow down gradually by taking your foot off the gas and using light braking. Pull off the road in a safe place to stop.
